textos.Toca Grabar (o el ícono ● de la barra de: Click Record (or the ● icon in the menu bar) and explain whatever you want to show.
textos.Toca Terminar: Graba transcribe en tu co: Click Finish: Graba transcribes on your computer, without uploading anything.
textos.El archivo subtitulos.srt está en la car: The subtitulos.srt file is in this recording's folder. In YouTube Studio: Subtitles → Add language → Upload file → "With timing".
textos.Convierte tu voz en texto dentro de tu c: Turns your voice into text on your computer. Downloaded only once.
textos.El mejor resultado; recomendado con 8 GB: Best results; recommended with 8 GB of RAM or more.
textos.Graba tu pantalla con tu cámara y tu voz: Record your screen with your camera and voice. When you finish, the app transcribes on your computer and your AI gets everything ready.

Record your screen with your camera and voice. When you finish, the app transcribes on your computer and your own AI writes notes, a YouTube script, titles, a description with chapters and subtitles. Nothing is uploaded to any server.
textos.Graba usa la IA que ya tienes, con tu cu: Graba uses the AI you already have, with your account. We test it with a short question.
textos.Más rápido y pequeño; para Macs con poca: Faster and smaller; for Macs with little memory.
For the bubble with your face.

For your voice and the transcription.
textos.Recibes notas, un guion para YouTube, tí: You get notes, a YouTube script, titles, a description with chapters and subtitles.
textos.Se va a la Papelera con el video, las no: It goes to the Trash with the video, notes and subtitles. You can recover it from there.
textos.Si siempre hablas en el mismo, elegirlo: If you always speak the same one, choosing it improves the transcription.
textos.Todo se procesa en tu computador. La IA: Everything is processed on your computer. The AI uses your own account.
textos.Tu IA está escribiendo las notas y el gu: Your AI is writing the notes and the script…
textos.macOS pide permiso para grabar la pantal: macOS asks for permission to record the screen, camera and microphone. You can change them anytime.
